misc-mem-01-c1.quote: The term meme was introduced by the biologist Richard Dawkins in his book The Selfish Gene (1976).
misc-mem-01-c1.claim: In The Selfish Gene (1976), Richard Dawkins coined the word meme for the cultural counterpart of the gene
